scenes.title: Robin Dunbar plotting 38 primate cranial casts along the neocortex-ratio graph up to the human '150' mark
scenes.era: 1992, University College London comparative anthropology laboratory

layout.description: Sunlit 1992 UCL anthropology seminar room with a long natural-oak specimen table displaying comparative matte-white porcelain primate endocast models in ascending size (prosimian, matte-white porcelain macaque cast, baboon cast, chimpanzee cast, modern human cast) in front of a crisp log-log regression board.

positions.who: Robin Dunbar (mannequin in 1992 tweed blazer and open-collar shirt)
positions.where: standing at the regression board extending the straight primate trendline from chimpanzee (~50-55) up to the human 4.1 neocortex ratio landing squarely at '~150'
aligning the matte-white matte-white porcelain chimpanzee and human cranial endocasts along the oak table beside ethnographic village/company ledgers

props.name: ascending row of five matte-white primate cranial endocasts
props.period_detail: museum-grade white 3D casts showing dramatic outer neocortical folding expansion from small prosimians to humans
props.physical_behavior: makes the 4.1 neocortex ratio physically tangible

props.name: log-log Neocortex Ratio vs Group Size chart
props.period_detail: large white placard plotting 38 primate dots climbing tightly up to Human = 147.8 (~150)

props.name: historical ~150 ledger cards ('Neolithic Village: 150 / Roman Maniple: 130 / Hutterite Split: 150')
props.period_detail: crisp comparison cards stacked on the table
props.physical_behavior: confirm the biological prediction in real human history

actions.verb_sequence: sets the large human white endocast at the right end of the primate row
draws the dotted vertical line from '4.1 Neocortex Ratio' up to the primate slope and across to '150 Group Size' -> taps the matching Hutterite & Roman company cards

reactions.reaction: compares the failed 'fruit-range' scatter plot against the tight 'social group' line in amazement
sketches the nested 5 — 15 — 50 — 150 concentric rings beside the graph

scenes.wardrobe: 1992 British academic attire: warm herringbone tweed jacket, blue Oxford shirt, corduroy trousers.
scenes.lighting: High-key London tall-window daylight illuminating matte-white museum endocasts.
scenes.recognition_hook: Line up 38 matte-white porcelain primate brain casts by outer-cortex size, extend the line to humans, and it lands on 148 — the exact size where villages split and startups suddenly need HR.

key_visual.description: a 1992 anthropologist at a UCL oak table lined with ascending matte-white primate brain casts pointing to a 'Neocortex Ratio -> 150 Group Size' regression chart

scenes.title: Concentric 5 / 15 / 50 / 150 circle tabletop map

positions.where: placing 5 tallest wooden pegs right into the innermost '3 a.m. Crisis Circle'

props.name: concentric wooden-peg social board
props.period_detail: 5 inner pegs absorb 40% of social time

actions.verb_sequence: counts thousands of phone contacts -> places just five into the center ring

scenes.title: 5,000 online 'friends' vs ~150 real two-way replies

layout.description: Bright monitor showing a giant starburst of 4,000 faint passive links shrinking when filtered to mutual two-way conversations — leaving a crisp ~150 core.

positions.where: toggling the 'Mutual Replies Only' filter on the network graph

props.name: 1.7-million-user network plateau graph
props.period_detail: curve flattening between 100 and 200 regardless of follower count
